summary: Add multi-criteria cleanup profiles, cross-field conflict veto, and explainable non-LLM/LLM triage

delivery.outcome: Add five named multi-criteria cleanup profiles (balanced, disk_emergency, git_hygiene, dedupe_conservative, llm_triage_focus), add cross-field conflict veto CLEAN-CONFLICT-001 (addressing Validator #26 advisory finding), add per-candidate ruleTrace and LLM brief triageQueue ordering, and update standard documentation v2.
nonGoals: Perform filesystem mutations or execute cleanup deletions from the standard module
Modify pinned git-lifecycle JSON Schemas, GBNF grammar, or .lifecycle profiles

architecture.decision: Extend the closed workspace-cleanup schema and modular stdlib evaluators cleanly within their < 500-line module budgets, exposing profile presets via CRITERIA_PROFILES and --profile while isolating LLM triage ordering inside standard/workspace_cleanup_llm.py.
interfaceChanges: Extend workspace-cleanup schema and CLI with profileId, heuristicMode, ruleTrace, CLEAN-CONFLICT-001, and triageQueue
dataChanges: Update standard/workspace-cleanup-policy.schema.json with profileId, heuristicMode, and evaluation ruleTrace
